info.name: NepalGo
info.description: NepalGo backend requests. Select the 'NepalGo Local' environment. CUSTOMER and OPS tokens are fetched automatically; SUPER_ADMIN uses folder 00 (needs an authenticator code).

item.name: 00 Tokens (manual)
Customer: exchange idToken for NepalGo tokens
SUPER_ADMIN step 2: MFA verify (edit the 6-digit code!)

request.description: Replace 000000 in the body with the current code from your authenticator app, then Send. pendingToken expires in 5 minutes.

item.description: Optional: the folders below fetch CUSTOMER and OPS tokens automatically. SUPER_ADMIN needs the two-step flow here.

request.description: Spec 15.2. 204 deleted (also on retry), 409 ACCOUNT_DELETION_BLOCKED while a payment is being verified, 503 = retry. Use a THROWAWAY customer.

exec: // Returns true if the JWT is missing, unreadable, or expires within 60 seconds.
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: env('customerEmail'), password: env('customerPassword'), returnSecureToken: true }) }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('Customer auto-login: Firebase sign-in failed', err || res.text()); return; }
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ idToken: res.json().idToken }) }
if (err2 || res2.code !== 200) { console.error('Customer auto-login: exchange failed', err2 || res2.text()); return; }
